olivia: PR #501 is blocked on an eng confirmation about model routing + cache semantics before we can merge the migration guide. CI preview failed linkcheck and reviewers marked it as blocking. tagging eng.
matt: Link?
olivia: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/501 51. Preview log says unresolved reference to /reference/routing#model-variant and reviewers are asking whether cached responses can come from fallback models.
ops-bot: docs-preview failed 1: linkcheck error at migration-guide.md: unresolved reference '/reference/routing#model-variant' (line 33)
hannah: Quick answer on routing/caching: cached responses are keyed by the model variant actually used to serve the request. If the smart router falls back to a cheaper model, the cache key reflects that fallback. So you won't get a cached response from a different model variant.
matt: Important for the docs: do we expose that behavior as a guarantee? Some customers rely on deterministic outputs.
hannah: It's a documented guarantee for Hosted and Dedicated. For Private, admins can opt into cross-variant caching via runtime.cache.allow_cross_variant = true but it defaults to false.
olivia: Can you paste the exact config snippet + anchor text so I can fix the reference and update the doc language?
hannah: Add this to reference/routing.md under anchor #model-variant:
```
# model variant caching
cache.key_by: model_variant
cache.allow_cross_variant: false  # hosted/dedicated default
```
For Private: runtime.cache.allow_cross_variant: true|false
ops-bot: preview requested: https://deploy-preview-501--docs.redwood-inference.com 1: status: pending
docs-bot: Also note: reviewers requested clarity on TTL semantics when fallback occurs.
matt: TTL question: if model A returns and is cached, then we later route to fallback B for a similar request, do we serve A's cached result? From your earlier answer, no, but what about TTL resets when we populate cache via fallback?
hannah: TTL applies per key (model_variant + prompt hash). If fallback B populates the cache for B, that TTL is independent. No cross-variant substitution unless cross-variant caching is enabled.
olivia: I've added the anchor and the config snippet, and clarified Private behavior. Pushed a tiny change.
ops-bot: preview requested: https://deploy-preview-501--docs.redwood-inference.com 1: status: success :tada:
matt: I'll do a quick content pass. Who's the approval reviewer? I can approve content but need product to OK the customer-facing phrasing.
olivia: Product reviewer is @rachel, but Rachel is OOO today. Can we get a triage approval from the docs lead to merge this morning? We have a partner migration scheduled later today.
hannah: Engineering sign-off here. Docs lead can approve the phrasing; Matt can handle spellcheck + merge once docs lead gives the go-ahead.
docs-bot: Note: CI policy requires 2 approvals for changes to reference pages. If Rachel is OOO, ask the docs lead or schedule a quick async review.
matt: I'll ping the docs lead and keep this on my radar. Thanks all.
